verdict.rationale: Folk documents custom objects: record types defined inside a group, such as Projects, Job Applications or Partnerships. It exposes custom object endpoints with an objectType path parameter, and Deals themselves use those endpoints. Custom objects are a paid-tier feature. However, the evidence only shows custom fields on people and companies. It never shows custom fields on custom object types, relationships between objects, or a developer defining object schemas programmatically. missing for 10: documented custom fields on custom objects, relationship/lookup modeling between objects, API-level schema definition, independent hands-on corroboration.
